query_analysis.original_query: Develop a comprehensive risk assessment protocol for handling spent adsorbents in high-temperature industrial filtration processes.
query_analysis.expanded_query: Develop a detailed and thorough risk assessment protocol specifically designed for the safe handling and management of spent adsorbents from high-temperature industrial filtration processes, ensuring compliance with all relevant safety and environmental regulations.

selected_agents.role: Lead the development of the risk assessment protocol and ensure regulatory compliance
Provide technical details on spent adsorbents and filtration processes
Assist with integrating process considerations into the risk assessment

communication_strategy.information_flow: Technical data and process information flow from process experts to the Safety Expert for risk analysis
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Iterative refinement of risk assessment with continuous input from process experts

clarification_questions: What specific types of spent adsorbents are involved and what are their physical and chemical properties?
What are the current handling procedures and known risks associated with the spent adsorbents?
Are there specific regulations or industry standards that must be followed in the risk assessment protocol?
